comment: Shared Control and Model Plane vector for the starter browser run stop decision payload digest (D21h, model.space.browser_run_stop, audience model-plane-model-gateway, schema sha256:space-browser-run-stop-v1, permission space:browser:stop). Control's copy is browserRunStopPayloadDigest in space_browser_run_stop_decision.go; the model-gateway verifier (mp-contracts space_browser.rs) must recompute the same bytes and pin these digests. Change them only on an intended wire change, on both sides. Each length-prefixed field is name, NUL, 8-byte big-endian length, value; the five revisions are name, NUL, 8-byte big-endian value. Each vector's user_id replaces input.user_id. The digests were computed by a standalone script, independent of the Go code; TestBrowserRunStopDigestGolden must confirm them.
